a.lede: Google's Gemini app for Mac can now use your computer to list items on eBay, speed up creative tasks and fill out forms for you.
a.title: Google boosts Gemini's ability to do 'repetitive tasks' on its Mac app

b.lede: AI training and chat history will now have separate toggles in the Gemini activity settings.
b.title: Google makes it easier to use Gemini without training AI on your data
